editorial:
Imagine being so broke and tired of your art career that you actually listen to your weird roommate's idea to rob a bank. That is exactly where you land with this movie. You get to follow a frustrated artist who is totally out of his element and a roommate who thinks he is a mastermind because he has seen a few heist movies. The whole vibe is lighthearted and chaotic, making it feel like a comedy of errors where everything that can go wrong actually does. It is a fun ride because you can tell these guys are completely unprepared for the real world.

What really works here is the chemistry between the two leads and the way the pacing keeps you laughing at their bad decisions. While the action is not as polished as a big Hollywood blockbuster, the charm comes from how messy the heist is. If you love movies where the bad guys are actually just clueless amateurs, you will have a blast. You should definitely try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or maybe grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection if you want to keep it forever.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart in the final act as the duo realizes that movie logic does not work in real life. After a series of clumsy mistakes and narrow escapes, the bank robbery fails completely. You see them face the consequences of their poor planning in a funny way. The movie wraps up by showing that they are better off as struggling artists than as criminals, leaving you with a laugh as they accept their fate.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies about people failing miserably at crimes.
